description: This file defines the class RqlPredicateParser, which implements the PredicateParser interface to parse RQL predicate strings into an abstract syntax tree (RootNode). It acts as a wrapper around an internal parser implementation.

classes.name: RqlPredicateParser
classes.description: A parser class that implements PredicateParser to parse RQL predicate strings into a RootNode structure.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the input string containing RQL predicates and returns the root node of the resulting AST.
